nom: URIAGE Age lift fluide jour lissant fermeté 40ml

avis.texte: I love the ingredients in this product. I have found a lot of success using retinol on my aging skin - I'm in my mid-40s - and after a year of using it, I have noticed a definite reduction in fine lines around my eyes. If you're new to using retinol, start with only a few times per week, and then work up to daily. This product is wonderful - it is lightweight and absorbs quickly. No residue or tacky feeling at all. It has a floral scent that I didn't mind, and it dissipates after a few minutes. The dispenser features a locking mechanism, which makes this easy to travel with - no accidental leaks.

avis.titre: Texture leggera, effetto tensore visibile ma non miracoloso
avis.texte: Sto usando questo fluido da mesi, ogni mattina. La sua consistenze fluida si assorbe subito senza ungere lasciando la pelle liscia e con una sensazione di compattezza. Il profumo è delicato e piacevole. Dopo i primi giorni la pelle appare più distesa, anche se le linee più marcate non spariscono. In conclusione è un ottimo prodotto di fascia farmaceutica, ideale soprattutto per pelli da normali a miste o lucide.
Me encanta este suero, lomiso por las mañanas junto con la crema de ojos y cara, estos productos están muy bien calificados y son de alta calidad.

I have never used anything anti-age before. This moisturizes my skin and I put my make-up on after applying it. I don't know that I notice my wrinkles looking any different so far, but I like the way it goes on. I am applying it every morning. There is a scent which I don't typically like. The scent is light and I don't notice it shortly after application. It only squirts out a small amount so you do need to push it a few times to get enough to cover your whole face.
